items.rationale: 64,000 has reached the 50,000 tier but not the 100,000 tier, so the rate is 4%. The commission is 64,000 x 4% = 2,560.
50,000 >= 100,000 is FALSE, but 50,000 >= 50,000 is TRUE because >= includes the boundary itself, so the rep gets the middle rate of 4%.
A nested IF returns the result of the first test that is TRUE. Every rep has sales >= 0, so a test on the lowest tier would always be TRUE first and nobody would reach the higher tiers.
Each IF separates one tier from the tiers below it, and the last tier is simply what remains, so 5 tiers need 5 - 1 = 4 IF functions.
